results.title: Pepita the Gunslinger
results.overview: Mar del Plata, 1985. Pregnant and working as a sex worker, Margarita Di Tullio defies the mafia and a corrupt power structure to build a clandestine empire that shields women from the horrors of the streets, becoming a legend forged by a shotgun and maternal loyalty… the legend of Pepita, the Gunslinger.

results.title: Beyond the Wetlands
results.overview: Two researchers from Karachi arrive at Hushe Valley near the K2 mountain for a research project on global warming. When one of the researcher vanishes into the cold and treacherous valley, a search and rescue mission is organized to find the missing person.

results.title: Самая лёгкая лодка в мире
results.overview: A feature film based on the novella by Yuri Koval, recounting a whimsical and humorous journey aboard a homemade boat through the Vologda region. The picture consists of two parallel storylines. The first follows the adventures of the novella’s protagonist, whose absurd escapade unexpectedly transforms into a mystical experience amidst the rivers, marshes, and villages of the countryside. The second centers on a theatrical production based on Koval’s book — staged by a group of students — which reveals the backstory: how the book’s hero came to yearn to break free from Moscow and retreat far away from everyone — including his friends — deep into the heart of nature.

results.title: The Dark Domain: Mickey-vs-Winnie
results.overview: A century after two convicts are swallowed by a cursed forest, a group of ex-reform school survivalists reunite at their decaying Hell camp. Their trip spirals into terror as the convicts rise as mutated twisted childhood icons.

results.title: Life After You
results.overview: After her sister’s sudden death, an ambitious assistant director puts her dreams of working abroad on hold to raise her orphaned niece and face a family history she thought she could leave behind.

results.title: 13 Teen
results.overview: A high school teen struggles with peer pressure and drugs, navigating choices that could shape his future forever.

results.title: The Woman Before Me
results.overview: When Jenna learns her husband was once married to a woman who could be her double, she unravels a chilling pattern of obsession, deceit, and murder that makes her question whether she’s his next victim.

results.title: Hunger Strike Breakfast
results.overview: A desperate hunger strike meant to capture global media attention slowly unravels into a hilariously bleak showdown between ambition, reality, and an empty stomach.

results.title: Black Men Don't Cheat 3: Outplayed
results.overview: They said black men don't cheat - but somebody's definitely lying. And this time, everybody's getting caught up.

results.title: Dernier vol
results.overview: Solly Bertone, whose real name is Solange Berton, is ending her 32-year career as a senior flight attendant on Hexagone Air flights. After five years of enduring domestic flights with the low-cost subsidiary, she is hoping for one last prestigious trip. But during her final briefing at Roissy, she discovers that she has been assigned to a flight to Bergerac, a destination that infuriates her.

results.title: The Hunt for the Next Lamine Yamal
results.overview: They are teenagers and the future of football. SVT chronicles the talent search, a process in which the majority of children are rejected. During the World Cup, 18-year-old Lamine Yamal is one of the tournament's major stars. Meanwhile, an intensive effort is underway to nurture the next generation of stars. At Benfica, players as young as five are scouted. Denmark was an early adopter of viewing academy players as commodities. In the UK, the situation ended so tragically for two young boys that they took their own lives. At home, an intense debate is raging, with the push for early elite-level development dividing the football community.

results.title: Effortless: The Eddie Fiola Story
results.overview: Follows BMX legend and Hollywood stuntman Eddie Fiola's career, personal life, and pursuit of making it to the top in his sport and second career as an elite stuntman on some of the biggest budget movies in Hollywood.

results.title: Only Known to Us
results.overview: Set largely within the confines of a hospital ward, the film follows a crisis involving long-time partners Neil and Bong. When Bong falls severely ill, the situation forces a reunion with his estranged parents, Benjie and Gloria, bringing long-standing family rifts and unspoken truths to the surface.

results.title: Life in pink like in the movies
results.original_title: La vie en rose comme dans les films
results.overview: 19 Super 8 film reels, bought in a second hand store, make a young filmmaker take a plunge into the past of an unknown family. He decides to give back this holy shrine, full of memories, to their legitimate owner. When confronted with reality, the image of a perfect family vanishes. This movie is both an ethical gesture and an interesting essay on the relationship between movie pictures and memory.

results.title: A River's Gaze
results.overview: Lavinia, a single mother trying to make a better life on her own terms for herself and her 13-year-old son, live in a poor Romanian village. She is impulsive, prone to misreading situations, and not sure how to love. But her son, on the threshold between childhood and adolescence, needs his mother more than ever, and over the course of four seasons their relationship is put to the test.

results.title: Sooriya Sulanga
results.overview: Against a backdrop of deep-rooted conflict and intense romance, ordinary individuals are pushed to their absolute limits when a complex web of relationships begins to unravel. To survive a turbulent storm of high-stakes adversity, they must navigate unexpected choices to protect what matters most.

results.title: The Call
results.overview: Through a series of increasingly desperate phone calls, a mother's world unravels as her gay son is pursued and harassed by his former school bullies.

results.title: Grunk The Smasher
results.overview: In an age of grim violence and gore-drenched savagery, a brave warrior embarks on an epic adventure to rescue a beautiful harem girl from the clutches of insidious evil. Journey with Grunk as he braves the Catacombs of Madness, bargains with fiendish witches, and smashes strange and fantastic creatures in his quest to quench his lusty barbarian appetites.
